source: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints (CDLA Permissive 2.0); ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 class 50 (built-up) on this model's grid; OSM buildings, roads and hotels
edits: 2266 buildings are Microsoft's ML building footprints where OSM maps none (detected by a model from Bing Maps imagery, 2014-2024; it can miss or merge houses), the nearest the arrival within 1100 m: each is drawn as the rectangle round its footprint; storeys, walls and roofs are illustrative.

334 illustrative houses stand where ESA WorldCover 2021 maps built-up land (55523 cells of 10 m in this model) and neither OSM nor the ML footprints show a building within 30 m: at most one per cell, nearest the arrival, within 1100 m, kept off roads, rivers, the landmark's grounds and slopes over 35 degrees. Their size, height, walls and roofs are illustrative, after visitors' photos of Swat villages (stone, timber and mud or tin roofs above about 1,250 m; plaster and brick below).
The 1 hotels OSM maps only as named points are drawn there as three-storey blocks; their footprint, height and roof colour are illustrative.
